name: Sarufutsu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sarufutsu village emblem in red and navy: a three-armed device of red and navy blades around a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Sarufutsu, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 9 May 1968.

features.role: Sarufutsu village emblem — a three-armed device of red and navy blades around a ring
